items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I don't know whether you remember A.J.

ctx.x: Next time I'm here I'll try to get to talk to him. I never met him. He used to be a fine drummer too. Is he fairly young or old or something? Well, I think he's about my age. He might be a year or two older than I am, but not very much more than that. Then there's another fellow in Chicago too from New Orleans, his name is Ransom Nolan. But he wasn't, I don't think he was born in New Orleans, but he had moved to New Orleans at an early age and he stayed around there. And he worked with several of the bands around…

Peerron. No, I met his widow. I knew Clarence Williams, his partner in the music business. Yes. I went down there to meet him one year and he died a few months before and I talked to his widow that summer.
